purpose: Items that a human reviewer must look at before anything is uploaded or cited. Each item names the evidence file or public URL to check. Nothing here was resolved by the agent unless the 'status' says so.

items.title: Repo verdicts contradict each other on whether the recommended file may be submitted
items.detail: README section 0 and docs/index.html say 'OK TO DOWNLOAD AND SUBMIT ONE FILE' for the UWBP-DRCS-EXP3 nan.tif. The same lane's run card (docs/evidence/run_card_uwbp_drcs.json) says verdict 'negative', ok_to_submit false, slot_used false, and its promotion gates are holdout=false, paired_improvement=false, surface=false, final=false, same_registry=false, format=false (the format gate was false on 2026-10-28 even though the validator passes today).
items.status: OPEN - owner decision required; this session corrects the top banner to say download-only until selector sign-off

items.title: User-quoted leaderboard figures do not match the public leaderboard
items.detail: The request quotes 0.4413 as the leaderboard high and 0.3195 as the 'highest right now'. The public DrivenData leaderboard fetched 2026-10-31 shows #1 xiaofanhu 0.4544, #2 cfld__ 0.3925, #3 Batik Shirt Brothers 0.3917 (column: best public DW-Tversky, public test set). Neither quoted figure appears. The site list's highest focus-site value is 0.2778 (GEMSDOE32, USER-REPORTED).
items.status: OPEN - the user's figures are not treated as leaderboard facts

items.title: Holdout surrogate does not rank organizer scores
items.detail: docs/evidence/proxy_vs_organizer_calibration.json: Spearman organizer vs hide-recover = -0.10 (p=0.74); organizer vs SGMC-CAL = +0.58 (p=0.039), n=13 with duplicated rasters. The hide-recover column in that file uses the diagnostic full-map path, which the evaluator itself labels 'not promotion evidence', so the -0.10 is a weak test of the fold-local metric; the SGMC-CAL correlation rests on 13 non-independent points.
items.status: OPEN - no proxy in the repo is validated against organizer receipts | INHERITS B1: the holdout reads the mirror whose labels.tif equals existing_faults.tif (docs/review-20261031-labels.md)

items.title: Random placement scores about half the champion on the hide-recover surrogate
items.detail: Experiment X1 canary: random dots with the same count (41,696 pre-gate) score HOLDOUT-DTI 0.047237 (CI 0.043343-0.050838) versus 0.099202 for the champion. The pre-registered expectation was near zero; it was wrong. The surrogate is coverage-dominated at this density.
items.status: RECORDED - surrogate defect; any future canary must use this baseline | INHERITS B1: the holdout reads the mirror whose labels.tif equals existing_faults.tif (docs/review-20261031-labels.md)

items.title: Fold-honest label for the champion control depends on an unverified owner surface
items.detail: The control 'CHAMP-D28-VIS-B2' is labelled fold-honest, but it is built from the owner's H19-5 surface (data/scored/gems19-h19-5-...-nan.tif, 121,131 px). The repo verified fold-locality for its own lane only. Whether the owner's H19-5 surface used withheld holdout segments is NOT verified.
items.status: OPEN - needs the owner's H19-5 build log | INHERITS B1: the holdout reads the mirror whose labels.tif equals existing_faults.tif (docs/review-20261031-labels.md)

items.title: Uniqueness: literal rule fails against one saturating reference
items.detail: Literal rule (within-3px <= 70% vs every reference) fails for the UWBP file only against data/scored/13gems_20261001_r13-lattice-s5_v2_nan-outside.tif, whose 3-px footprint coverage is 99.87%, so it cannot discriminate. Detector-only rule passes against all 23 references, including the nine focus sites (max within-3px 0.338, against 8GEMSDOE Hedge-v2).
items.status: OPEN - team must decide whether to exempt the lattice reference (README open decision)

items.title: Template labelled 'total absence' contains the label positives
items.detail: The official problem page says 'A sample submission that predicts total fault absence is provided'. data/sample_submission.tif contains 60,988 pixels equal to 1 inside the footprint, identical to data/labels.tif positives (checked 2026-10-31). The template is therefore not an absence-only file; the repo uses it only for grid, CRS, transform and footprint.
items.status: RECORDED - do not treat the template as a null prediction

items.title: GEMSDOE25 and GEMSDOE30 have identical dot masks under different file bytes
items.detail: Both list 0.2600 and 44,090 dots. Their SHA-256 values differ (91eae1ca... vs 8cf893ea...), but evidence/nine_site_summary.json reports exact_mask_equal = true (Jaccard 1.0). This session's own check showed the bytes differ only. Treat them as one submission, not two independent sites. Also: GEMSDOE24 and 27 have Jaccard 0.98, and 31/32/36 have 0.91 to 0.97.
items.status: RECORDED (mask-level identity confirmed by main's audit; the organizer-side meaning is unverified)

items.title: Training inputs come from owner mirrors, not the organizer
items.detail: data/training_features.tif, labels.tif and sample_submission.tif were restored from pinned GitHub owner mirrors, not from DrivenData (login required). The restore receipt says 'hash-pinned owner mirror; not organizer-authenticated'. Hashes prove consistency with the owner mirror only.
items.status: OPEN - authenticated download needed from the DrivenData data page

items.title: Portal range error: how to avoid it
items.detail: The portal rejected an earlier file with 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]'. The official rules say values must be float32 in [0, 1] with null or NaN outside bounds. The UWBP -nan.tif is float32, nodata tag nan, values {0, 1} inside the footprint and NaN outside (validator PASS, 2026-10-31). Upload the -nan.tif, not the -zeros.tif diagnostic.
items.status: RESOLVED IN FILE - portal behaviour itself not observed by the agent

items.title: Spacing arms 3.2 and 3.6 are identical
items.detail: emitter.dot_thin uses integer squared offsets, so min_dist 3.2 and 3.6 select the same pixels (30,059 dots, identical scores). The effective spacings are sqrt(8), 3, sqrt(10), 4, not continuous values.

items.title: Reimplemented spacing control is not byte-identical to the owner file
items.detail: dot_thin at 2.828 gives 44,271 pre-gate pixels versus 44,090 in the owner file (100% of owner pixels inside 3 px of the reimplementation). The owner file is used for all reproduction claims.

items.title: Forum citation not re-fetched
items.detail: The repo cites DrivenData forum thread 11516 on known-fault masking. It was not fetched in this session, so the masking claim is carried over from the repo and not re-verified.

items.title: B1 (from main's review): labels.tif and existing_faults.tif are byte-identical
items.detail: Both files are 60,988 positives with SHA-256 7ba308cc... in the restored owner mirror (re-verified in this session). The official page describes the test labels as new faults. Every hide-and-recover holdout that reads these files is invalid until the organizer download is compared. This session's X1 holdout, canary and projection inherit this.
items.status: OPEN - blocks all holdout claims; owner/organizer label comparison required

items.title: B2 (from main's review): competition inputs are third-party mirrors
items.detail: Training features, labels, existing faults and the sample template came from other teams' GitHub repositories, not from DrivenData. This session restored them the same way. Hashes prove mirror consistency only. The team should check whether using third-party copies of a login-gated dataset breaches the competition data terms.

items.title: B8 (from main's review): one submission per team is final
items.detail: The official page says competitors must choose a single submission for scoring across both rounds before the deadline. A weekly-cap workflow cannot replace choosing one well-tested file. Any upload must be a deliberate final pick by the team.
